title: Network policies and isolation between namespaces

videos.script: Lesson 18 ended with a fact that surprises people. Any pod in the cluster can reach any other pod, in any namespace. A namespace separates names. It does not separate traffic. {{flat}} A NetworkPolicy is how you change that. It selects some pods, and lists who may talk to them, and whom they may talk to. {{policy}} There is a catch, and this lesson starts with it. The API server stores a policy. It does not enforce one. The network plugin does, if it can. {{catch}} You will write a policy that blocks everything, watch it block nothing, change the plugin, and then open the paths the shop actually needs, one at a time. {{plan}}
